correctness.rationale: In the chamber 0<r<1, H/r²<s<1+H/r³, H=1+r+r², outer magnitudes evolve g(z)=r(z−1). Four successive outer visits would require g³(s)≥1, contradicted by upper chamber inequality. Thus any n=4q+j branch-regular prefix contains at least q inner steps and |(T^n)'|≥(sr³)^q r^j. The explicit positive u=(sr³−rH)/(1+sr³) is in (0,1); strict lower inequality sr²>H ensures the primitive period-eight itinerary IOOOIOOO with T⁴(u)=−u and eight-step multiplier (sr³)². The witness achieves infimum log(sr³)/4 and disproves positive uniform growth when sr³≤1; if >1 choose rho=(sr³)^(1/4), C=(r/rho)^3. Independent exact rational parameters checked orbit formulas and strict itinerary for several chamber points. Boundary-hitting trajectories correctly excluded.
